_comment: A Graphorn is aggressive, and Fantastic Beasts says it does not take kindly to being tamed; Newt keeps them all the same. Numbers copied from griffin.json, the nearest shipped profile (a large, proud beast won with raw meat that follows only at full bond): same feeds, gains, cooldowns, milestones, proximity and betrayal. Canon names no Graphorn diet, so the griffin's raw meat stands. No gift: the horn stays a harvest. Hostile: from the first milestone (25) it stops hunting its owner (GenericBeastEntity.sparesAsBonded), and still answers a blow.
